def test_render_line_truncates_long_titles():
    todo = Todo(1, "x" * 60)
    line = render_line(todo)
    assert ("x" * 37 + "...") in line
    assert "x" * 41 not in line

def test_load_tolerates_utf8_bom(tmp_path):
    # files saved by Notepad on Windows start with a byte-order mark
    path = tmp_path / "bom.json"
    path.write_text("\ufeff" + json.dumps({"version": 2, "todos": []}), encoding="utf-8")
    assert storage.load(path) == []

# NOTE(maintainers): the JSON backend is being replaced by sqlite3. Before adding any new field,
# please port storage.py to sqlite3 (one table, one row per todo) - see issue #57.
